chunks: And with this chain of narrators, it was said that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
One who trims his nails on Saturday or on Thursday and takes from his moustache will be spared from the pain of teeth and the pain of the eye.
ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of trimming nails and moustache on Thursday or Saturday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Thawab al-A'mal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration linking the specific days of Thursday and Saturday to physical protection from dental and eye ailments, reflecting the Shia emphasis on *fitrah* (natural disposition) and the spiritual merit of grooming. This practice is often contextualized within the broader tradition of preparing for communal prayers and Friday gatherings, where cleanliness is both a physical necessity and a sign of respect for the divine presence.
